normative_extracts.quote: The Largest Contentful Paint API reports the render time of the largest image or text block visible within the viewport relative to navigation start.

normative_extracts.spec_section: W3C Event Timing: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
normative_extracts.quote: Interaction to Next Paint measures the latency from user input until the next frame is presented after all event handlers, layout, and paint complete.

browser_support.notes: LCP and INP are standardized in Chrome/Firefox/Safari; CLS layout-shift entries remain Chromium-led.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Quantifies loading (LCP <= 2.5s), visual stability (CLS <= 0.1), and responsiveness (INP <= 200ms) directly from browser rendering and event-timing hooks.

production_failures.symptom: Lighthouse Lab score is 99/100 while Search Console flags Poor INP (> 350ms)
production_failures.root_cause: Lighthouse only simulates initial page load; real users tap filter menus and accordions that trigger synchronous React state updates and layout thrashing.
production_failures.mitigation: Instrument INP in production RUM and break up long click/keydown handlers with scheduler.yield() or Web Workers.

production_failures.symptom: LCP degrades to 4.2s despite fast 200ms TTFB
production_failures.root_cause: The LCP hero image URL was injected dynamically by client-side JS after hydration instead of appearing in server-rendered HTML.
production_failures.mitigation: Render the LCP element in initial HTML with fetchpriority="high" so the preload scanner fetches it immediately.
